description: This file defines repository classes for database operations related to a sports live-streaming platform. It includes classes for managing users, profiles, matches, events, emojis, reactions, and highlights, encapsulating SQLAlchemy ORM interactions with the database.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: A base class providing common database session handling for specific repositories.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository class for user-related database operations such as creating, retrieving, and updating users.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing user profile data.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository class for retrieving match information with different filtering and ordering options.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository class for event data operations, including fetching event lists and details.

classes.name: EmojiRepository
classes.description: Repository class for emoji assets, reactions, and reaction summaries.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing highlight content for matches.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user entry in the database with provided user data and a hashed password.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user record based on user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user record by email.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user record by username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Updates user details based on user ID and provided data.

methods.name: UserProfileDB create_profile(self, profile_data: UserProfileCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user profile with specified profile data.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_user_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a profile associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_id(self, profile_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves profile data using profile ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] update_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: UserProfileUpdate)
methods.description: Updates profile information based on profile ID and new data.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None, sport: Optional[SportType] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a list of matches with optional filters like status and sport type.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed match data, including related teams and events, by match ID.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Gets all matches currently marked as live.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Fetches upcoming matches within a specified window, default 7 days.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_more_matches(self, limit: int = 12, offset: int = 0, exclude_ids: List[str] = None)
methods.description: Returns a variety of matches including live, recent finished, upcoming, and others, with exclusions.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport: Optional[SportType] = None, featured: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Fetches paginated list of sports events with optional filtering by sport and featured status.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches single event details along with its matches.

methods.name: get_emojis(self, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of active emoji assets, with fallback for minimal schemas.

methods.name: Optional[EmojiAssetDB] get_emoji_by_id(self, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches emoji asset details by ID.

methods.name: str add_reaction(self, user_id: str, event_id: str, emoji_id: str, created_at: Optional[datetime] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new emoji reaction for an event/match by a specific user.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_reaction_summary(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Generates a summary of emoji reactions for an event, including counts and top emojis.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches highlights, optionally filtered by match ID.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific highlight by its ID.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_featured_highlights(self, limit: int = 10)
methods.description: Fetches the most recent and popular highlights marked as featured.

methods.name: __init__(self, session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: unavailable
